name: Morph
tagline: Design 3D objects in real space with voice and gestures, then export them for printing.

awards: MLH: Best Use of MongoDB Atlas

problem: CAD tools are slow and screen-bound.
solution: On AR glasses, users dimension real objects in context, describe new ones by voice for 3D reconstruction, edit by gesture, collaborate, and export printable files.
demo_moment: Team-described: look at a bike gear, resize it by voice, and export it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Use of MongoDB Atlas” among 261 submissions.
Designs in context of the real object.

lessons: Grounding design in the physical world is the AR advantage; show it.
